title: manuscript-guard completed reporting checklist
description: Where each checklist item is addressed in this manuscript. Journals ask for this file at submission; producing it as a build artefact rather than the night before means the gaps surface while there is still time to fix them, which is the only reason a reporting checklist is worth anything.

where.description: Section, and page or heading, where the item is addressed. Checked against the manuscript's actual headings, or a table or figure it places: 'Table 1', 'Figure S2'.

quote.description: The sentence, or a part of one of four words or more, that addresses the item, as the manuscript has it under the heading `where` names, subsections and the supplement included, or in the caption of the table or figure it names. Copied from the source with its bindings as written, or from the built document with their values; '...' stands for words left out. A heading alone is satisfied by any manuscript; the sentence is what a reviewer checks. Missing, left empty (a bare `quote:` is read as empty) or not found there, it is a warning from internal review and a failure at submission.

not_applicable.description: Why this item does not apply. A reason, not a tick: 'no interventions were assigned' rather than 'n/a'.
